1 Principal Cloud Consultant (m/w/x) Your Tasks
 * Strategic Leadership: Act as a trusted advisor, guiding customers through their cloud transformation journey.
 * Enterprise-Scale Solutions: Lead the design and execution of highly complex and large-scale cloud infrastructures.
 * Hands-on Expertise: While primarily strategic, you stay technically sharp and can step in when needed to ensure solutions are well-architected and efficiently implemented.
 * Infrastructure as Code: Maintain the ability to write and review Terraform, Pulumi, or other IaC solutions to support technical decision-making.
 * Project Delivery: Ensure successful project execution, aligning cloud initiatives with business goals and technical excellence.
 * C-Level Engagement: Consult and present cloud strategies to executive leadership, supporting decision-making at the highest level.
 * Thought Leadership: Represent SQUER as a cloud expert in conferences, publications, and industry forums.
 * Business Development: Build long-term customer relationships, drive cloud strategy discussions, and identify new business opportunities.

Your Qualifications
 * Consulting Excellence: Extensive experience in cloud consulting, customer advisory, and enterprise project leadership.
 * Technical & Business Alignment: Ability to balance hands-on expertise with strategic planning for cloud adoption.
 * Enterprise Cloud Architectures: Deep technical understanding of large-scale infrastructures and cloud security.
 * Infrastructure as Code: Strong background in Terraform Pulumi, or similar tools, with the ability to contribute to technical discussions and decisions.
 * Leadership: Strong track record in project execution and stakeholder management - combined with technical leadership to guide engineering teams towards successful delivery.
 * Public Speaking & Sales: Strong ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and engage in high-level sales discussions.
 * Inspiration & Influence: Passion for shaping ideas, driving innovation, and making an impact inside and outside of SQUER.
 * AI-native: You actively use AI-powered tools (e.g., code assistants, LLM-based workflows) to amplify your productivity and quality, or you're eager to start.
 * Communication: Ability to break down complex topics and explain them in a way that makes sense to both engineers and customers.
 * Languages: Fluent in English and German

Your Benefits
Why You'll Love Working at SQUER:

 * Learn & Grow: Tap into a € 5.000 annual training budget to sharpen your skills and take advantage of our in-house Leadership Academy. Join and be part of our active tech community through meetups, hackathons and training sessions. Get up to 40h/year additional time off for your personal education.
 * Flexibility for Performance: Benefit from hybrid work options, flexible hours, workations within the EU, and additional vacation days - giving you the freedom to perform at your best.
 * Tailored Tools for Success: Choose your preferred hardware configuration and leverage our suite of AI tools and licenses (Anthropic, OpenAI, and more) to suit your working style.
 * A Perks-Packed Workplace: Work in a central office with a spacious terrace and BBQ, enjoy free lunch in the office, MyClubs sports membership, and either a free "Wiener Linien" ticket or a partial contribution to the "Klimaticket". Plus, benefit from free massages, referral bonuses, Corporate Benefits, and JobRad. Annual employee presents and a monthly team breakfast add extra value to your work experience.
 *  Please refer to the application link for further information

We believe in transparent and fair compensation. For this role, the annual gross salary ranges between € 95.000 and € 105.000 - the exact placement depends on the seniority level we assess together during the process.

Put simply? That means reinventing everyday essentials.

And that takes the best and brightest minds.

This is a place where you can be ambitious.

Feel included and drive innovation. A place that celebrates big thinking, and creates exciting opportunities to learn and grow.

To become part of a place that celebrates purpose. To contribute to global change by being here.

What you will learn

 * Market observation on topics relevant to the respective department.

Big thinking. Serious doing.... 1 Data Analyst (m/f/d) - Data Team (Mid Level) We are looking for a Data Analyst with 3-5 years of experience to join our data team in Vienna. You will own the analytics layer in our client and venture projects, across three kinds of work: product analytics for the digital products we build, commercial analytics for new services and business models, and investment and portfolio analytics for our (Corporate) Venture Capital and Investment clients. You will work alongside our data engineers and get hands-on with the pipelines and models behind your dashboards.Your Responsibilities * Set up product analytics: tracking concepts, funnels, retention and cohort analyses. * Build commercial analytics for new services, including unit economics, pricing, contribution margin, adoption and revenue. * Develop data models and reporting for portfolio monitoring, performance tracking and investment decisions. * Write and optimise SQL for data models, transformations and analyses. * Support data pipelines and transformation layers: build models, test, resolve quality issues and extend flows. * Build and maintain useful Power BI dashboards for product, portfolio and commercial KPIs. * Define business metrics with stakeholders and align analytics with strategic goals. * Improve data quality, documentation and governance. * Own your workstream, priorities, timelines and dependencies;
